column7: ApproveSecretAccessRequest/RejectSecretAccessRequest (PUT /secret-access-requests/{requestId}, no route permission gate) checked the request kind, state, secret, expiry and maker != checker before the admin-authority check, so any signed-in user could read a request ID's existence, kind and state off the refusal, and an approve of an expired request wrote it to expired before the caller was authorized. Authority at the request's project is now checked first; an unauthorized caller gets "access request not found" for every ID and nothing is written (REST: TestResolveSecretAccessRequest_NonAdminIdenticalAnswer).
